description: Screen overrides for a bundle: all loose wires between the same two subsystems (or a subsystem and a terminal strip), worked out automatically and drawn on screen as one line with a tag (B1, B2…). Bundles never print (the PDF draws those wires separately) and don't derate. get_project lists them. Retag, name it, draw it as a trunk or as separate wires, everywhere or in one view, change its minimum wire count, or make it one multi-core cable (promote). null clears a field back to automatic. The project-wide minimum is update_project bundle_min. To make a bundle's wires a harness that prints, use update_harness from_bundle.

bundle.description: Bundle tag (B1) or key from get_project

min_wires.description: Fewest wires for this pair to draw as a bundle.

promote.description: These wires really are one multi-core cable: they become conductors of a new W-tagged cable landing on the same terminals.

show.description: Trunk or separate wires, in every view.

spec.description: With promote: the cable spec, e.g. "4×0.75 PUR"

view.description: With view_show: a subsystem name or id to set it for, or null for the top level.

view_show.description: Trunk or separate wires in that view; null goes back to `show`.
